themes.title: Transport Cost Cuts Spread Across Scandinavia
themes.blurb: Both Norway and Sweden see right‑wing parties championing reductions in user fees – Norway pushes to halve tolls while Sweden’s SD calls for extending fuel tax cuts. The framing emphasizes relief for drivers amid higher energy prices.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Advocates halving toll rates and touts the measure as optimistic for motorists.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Presses to extend temporary fuel‑tax cuts, arguing the war and market disruptions keep prices high.

themes.title: Far‑Right Parties Grapple with Internal Criticism
themes.blurb: Sweden’s Sweden Democrats and Norway’s Progress Party both face internal debates and criticism over strategy and leadership, highlighting a pattern of self‑scrutiny within European right‑wing movements.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Social Democrats critique SD’s electoral strategy; SD insiders debate focus on the party.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Local debates and polls spark criticism of FrP’s vague program and funding priorities.
